lines.en: I walk upright on my hind legs.
My head swivels side to side.
I jog two steps, then stop.
I move along the burrow mouth.
My tail is up.
I duck into the burrow and out again.
My steps on the sand are light.
I circle the group.
I stop and prick my ears.
I hop along.
I walk close to my fellows.
I shift over to the stone.
In savanna burrows, I walk and listen.
I run a few steps and look back.
I hop from the burrow to the stone.
I walk along my fellow's back.
I kick sand behind me.
I stop at the burrow and sniff.
I stand upright, watching the distance.
My forepaws are tucked to my chest.
I stand watch for the clan.
I shake the sand off my fur.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面听洞里的动静。
lines.en: Ear to the ground, I listen to the burrow.
I lower my tail.
I squat by the burrow mouth and squint.
I poke my head out of the burrow.
I lick the sand off my forepaw.
Are you watching us?
I stand to see far.
I am very near the burrow.
I tilt my head, ears toward you.
Go on. The others are watching.
I stand tall and keep watch for you.

lines.zh: 你的影子进了我的洞口。
lines.en: Your shadow has reached my burrow mouth.
Do not bend down; I cannot see far.
I flinch back toward the sand burrow.
I shriek to call the others.
That nearly knocked me over.
I shake the sand off.
Four legs, still quick.
I press to the sand.

lines.zh: 我把爪子重新抓紧沙面。
lines.en: I dig my claws into the sand again.
Tail up, I stare at you.
I dived back into the burrow.
Toss it. Don't hand it over.
I hop closer, one hop at a time.
That smell makes me sneeze.
Let me nose it first.
Hold still while I sniff.
I'll tell you once I eat.
Is anything bad nearby?
Step back and let the wind through.
Let me sniff again.
You bumped me and I flinched.
I am too small to bump you.
I dived into the burrow.
I peek out at you.
I duck back behind the stone.
We touched, and I ran.
Don't block the burrow.
I skirt the sand and go round.
I steady myself on the sand.
We live together as a group.
Too big for the burrow.
I'm on watch at the burrow.
I duck back into the burrow.
I have much to do.
Further from the burrow.
My fellows are waiting.
I'm not leaving. This is my burrow.
I sit down at the burrow mouth.
I run carrying it.
I can carry this.
I set it at the burrow mouth.
Let me pick it up and look.
I collect whatever falls.
My fellow saw me.
Better hide it fast.

lines.zh: 这颗蜘蛛眼，我闻得出用处。
lines.en: One sniff and I know what this spider eye is for.
You stepped on the burrow mouth.
I stand and shriek.
My fellows have all ducked in.
I stay to block.
Back off past the dune.
I count your footprints.
The burrow is very close.
One hop and I'm there.
Don't reach into the burrow.
I raise my tail.
My tail is up.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，全群都听见。
lines.en: My shriek carries to the whole clan.
You step, I hop.
I skirt the sand to your flank.
Do you hear the shrieking?
Come closer and it's too late.
I stay by the burrow.
I look down at your feet.
I track low along the ground.
My tail twitches.
I count your steps in the sand.
I back to the burrow mouth.
I claw with my forepaws.
That was very small.
I bump your shoe.
You lift a foot and I dive in.
I clamp onto your knuckle.

lines.zh: 我又咬了你的鞋带一口。
lines.en: I bite your shoelace again.
I stand upright to keep watch for the troop.
I retreat to the burrow.
I skid to a stop by the burrow.
The sun warms the sand.
First I stand and look.
My fellows are all here.
There are many burrows here.
I run to the stone.
I begin my watch.

lines.zh: 沙丘那头有动静，我立起来。
lines.en: Something stirs past the dune; I stand tall.
I raised my tail.
Fire nears and I dive into the burrow.
Water fills the burrow and I climb up.
The blast flips me over.
A draft grazes my spine.

lines.zh: 紫色的光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Violet light stings my eyes shut.
I haven't found insects in ages.

lines.zh: 雷光里我一下缩进洞里。
lines.en: The flash sent me into the burrow.
